content: Ẹmẹm cha Jekọb ọmaana Ẹsau

Mada Jekọb otzini chen, ore ọgbaanọkka Ẹsau da om-otzima anọng pẹ ẹnọhna okwu. Mando kw'ọtzọk va pẹ okkema ọnang abọkka. Ọtzọkha ọnang Lea, ọmaana Rachẹl, obiro ọtzọkha ọnang atzọhmnọng pabẹ p'ipanọng afa.
Wa ọtzọkha atzọhmnọng mba p'ipanọng ttara va pabẹ otzima ochi eden, Lea ttara va pẹ atzor bẹ nnam, yina Rachẹl ttara Josẹph an-akponga nnam.
Wa Jekọb ma for sẹ ochi eden orenga otzor ọgbaanọkka ka for. Mada ọbaang-ẹ ka for, ọrakha ottima itzitzikha k'irerek igbe izenamfa.
Yina, Ẹsau ọrọbh ọtza ọgọhma Jekọb, ọkhaar-ẹ mbọhk k'ekhokhora, obira ọbaakh-ẹ. Bẹ anọng afa abhom.
Mada Ẹsau otzini chen ore panọng ttara va, ọn-ọbọbh bi, “Bọng anọng bọ bọng atzọni kẹ-ẹ?” Jekọb obhin-ẹ bi, “Va p'Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọtzọhmnọng kwọ ọnanga k'ọphyaam, bọ mẹ e.”
Mẹ wọ, atzọhmnọng p'ipanọng ọmaana va pabẹ arenga atzor-ẹ ka for, bẹ arakha attima otzitzikha k'irerek anang-ẹ ikpokpobha.
Lea ttara va pẹ ajema, bẹ abira attima otzitzikha k'irerek, yina Rachẹl ttara Josẹph an-akpong nnam akwu attima itzitzikha k'irerek anang-ẹ ikpokpobha.
Ẹsau ọn-ọbọbh bi, “Anọng mba p'ira ngebh, ttara ngaan s'etzirakpo pya bẹ atzima akwu, atzọhmi bẹ bi, bẹ akwu asi yan o?” Jekọb oben bi, “Itta kwaam, ndim pyẹ bi ndọkha ọphyaam k'itzitzikha sọ e.”
Yina, Ẹsau on-oben bi, “Mma e, ọgbaanọkka kwaam, kọ khaama ekpo pyọ, kaam nkk'ekpo ngaama k'ọhaabh py'ebeng-m e.”

Jekọb, obhin-ẹ bi, “Mma o, ngwukh-ọ okhukhi. Kọ tzọkha ẹnanga cha nnang-ọ, idikha ọphyaam f'asi anang-m, ofon-ọ k'ettem. Ẹra cha kaam nnọ-ọ ma, okheri macha nne itzitzikha s'Ibinọkpaabyi e, da kọ atzọkh-m k'ọphyaam.

Tzotzokhaan, khera bi atzọkha ẹnanga nda cha nnang-ọ, da Ibinọkpaabyi okk'aam ọda ttara ọttọhk kpenamkpen fa kaam nnori.” Mada Jekọb ochin ororo ọgbana bi, ọgbaanọkka ọtzọkha ẹnanga cha ọnang-ẹ, Ẹsau okhera ọtzọkha.
Mando kw'Ẹsau on-obeni bi, “Tte mofona, kaam ńchọ-ọ eden.”

Yina, Jekọb oben-ẹ bi, “Itta kwaam, kọ arong kẹ bi, va paam atzima akhar-ọkhara, bẹ ẹfa kakhaam, ttara bi, etzirakpo pyaam etzim ẹrọkhi ayok p'ikhakhari ọrọk. Idikha motzim pyẹ orenga m'ẹbhar-ẹbhar, k'ewu dani chẹ-chẹ, pyẹ épe-ope biphyir.
Mẹ wọ, tte itta kwaam ochi ọtzọhmnọng kwẹ eden, ifha kaam ndima etzirakpo mbya ọmaana va mba, mfumetzen nnenga, matzẹmaa mokhebha ayok ka Seir.”
Mẹ wọ, Ẹsau on-oben bi, “Tte ntte anọng paam bani ọbọhk, bẹ atzọn-ọ abẹ.” Jekọb on-obhin-ẹ bi, “Sam e, itta kwaam, okhuri yan kw'abira ayak for sọ atzim o? Tte kaam ndọkha ọphyaam fọ fẹ-fẹ.”
M'ewu nduma dani, Ẹsau obina orenga okhuna ka Seir.
Yina, Jekọb ochina ka Sukọt. Kẹ wọ kw'iwa osi ọhọhm kw'owobh, obiro osi okhira f'etzirakpo pyẹ. Kẹ wọ osi bẹ ayeri ibe nnuma Sukọt.
Wa k'ekponga-nnam, Jekọb ofon ka Padan-Aram orenga maa okwu opyiri k'odedenmon kwa Shẹkẹm, k'ẹkhọma cha Kenaan, osi ibhingabe mẹ ọbaanga odedenmon nwa.
Wa Jekọb okwu odebh okhubha kw'irerek kw'ottim ikhira, ka mbọhk sa va pa Hamọr, kw'ode otte kwa Shẹkẹm, k'asilva arọbh azen.
M'ibe nna rọ sa Jekọb osi ijafọhnibe, obiro oyeri ibe nna Ibinọkpaabyi ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Israẹl.
